title: Timelords
description: Timelords is a custom-made incremental RPG Minecraft server featuring combat, mining progression, gear systems, and more.
body:
Timelords is an incremental RPG Minecraft server featuring custom mobs, mining progression, gear systems, and more. It was started in January of 2025 and has been in the works ever since. 

Timelords is joinable on both Minecraft Java (1.19.4+) and Bedrock editions using the IP **timelordsinc.net**. (Bedrock port 19132)
